sections.title: PH4H
sections.extract: The Pan-American Highway for Digital Health (PH4H) implementation guide describes the usage of the GDHCN for the Americas region.

sections.title: IPS Pilgrimage (IPS-Pilgrimage)
sections.extract: The IPS Pilgrimage implementation guide includes a machine-readable representation of WHO guidelines for verifiable IPS during pilgrimage. It explicitly encodes computer-interoperable logic, including data models, terminologies, and logic expressions, in a computable language to support implementation of IPS during pilgrimage usage scenario.
